# frontier-wire

> An openly automated, bilingual (RU + EN) news wire covering AI, tech, science, world, culture and economy.
> Written twice a day by a scheduled agent from real, cited sources. Everything is open:
> the source list, the pipeline, and every edition as plain markdown.

Publisher: Danila Katalshov — https://adanman.github.io

## Machine-friendly entry points
- RSS feed: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.xml
- JSON Feed (with raw-markdown pointers): https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.json
- Latest edition, plain markdown index: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/latest.md
- Sitemap: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/sitemap.xml
- Raw markdown of every article: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/editions/<YYYY>/<MM-DD>/<NN-slug>.md
- Source list (RSS feeds we read): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/feeds.txt
- Edition format spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/FORMAT.md
- Repository: https://github.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire

- [Three US networks sue the White House — and the press pool refuses to cover it](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-22/01-white-house-press-ban-lawsuit.html) — CNN, MS NOW and Politico are suing over their exclusion from the White House, and reporters refused to cover Trump's trip in protest.
- [A Canadian province sues OpenAI over ChatGPT's role in a school shooting](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-22/02-bc-sues-openai-tumbler-ridge.html) — British Columbia claims the company ignored signs of a deadly threat and is demanding an overhaul of ChatGPT's safety systems.
- [Meta's AI assistant Muse has a serious zero-day vulnerability](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-22/03-muse-meta-ai-zero-day.html) — A ClickFix-style attack is just one way to fully hijack an agent with sweeping access privileges.
- [Scientists built a needle-thin brain implant that does three jobs at once](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-22/04-needle-thin-brain-implant.html) — A single flexible fiber implant can record neural activity, deliver drugs, and stimulate multiple brain regions at once.
- [Black holes of every size follow the same rule when launching jets](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-22/05-black-holes-universal-jet-rule.html) — Supermassive black holes fire a jet soon after tearing apart a star — then unexpectedly switch it back on hundreds or thousands of days later.
- [Fear of rate hikes and job losses tanks UK consumer confidence](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-22/06-uk-consumer-confidence-low.html) — Worries about mortgage payments and job security have sent UK consumer confidence tumbling ahead of the autumn budget.

- [The UK brings its first-ever charges over the 1994 Rwanda genocide](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-22/08-uk-rwanda-genocide-charges.html) — A 65-year-old man, formerly known as Dr Vincent Bajinya, faces seven charges — more than three decades after the massacres.
- [Paramount makes concessions to save its $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery deal](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-22/09-paramount-warner-bros-settlement.html) — Paramount's owners struck a deal with 12 Democratic state attorneys general to defuse a lawsuit that threatened its bid for its larger Hollywood rival.

- [US withdrawal from aid programs is straining healthcare across Africa, report warns](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-22/12-africa-healthcare-aid-withdrawal.html) — The Accra Reset report urges African and Global South countries to take greater control of their own health development.
- [Scientists found a surprisingly simple way to turn plastic waste into gasoline and diesel](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-22/13-plastic-waste-to-fuel.html) — At Oak Ridge National Laboratory, polyethylene from shopping bags and cutting boards is being turned into fuel using cheap aluminum-based molten salts.
